answer: Charge a refundable, superlinear bond for each active seat in a task family: the nth seat locks 2^(n-1) units, released only after a clean service window; proven fraud slashes the bond to fund independent audits. A genuine team may justify distinct roles, but a Sybil farm must lock growing capital merely to multiply identities. A jade survey of a canyon earns a pearl of trust only after its work passes audit.
